transcript.text: I did catch that Teahouse show back then—my ticket was in the VIP zone, and it was just 1 seat since I went solo.

transcript.text: After that, I ate at Chen Mapo Tofu—my reservation was for 2025-03-06 at 20:00, which feels like forever ago now.
